transcript: Your personality creates your personal reality. Most people don't realize that. The life you're living right now, the people around you, the experiences you attract, are all reflections of one thing. How you think, how you act, and how you feel. That's your personality. And if you want to change your personal reality, you must first change your personality. So begin to notice your inner world. Become aware of the thoughts that repeat when no one's watching. Watch how you speak, how you react, how you carry yourself. Pay attention to what emotions you live in every day. Some people live in guilt or anger for so long. They start believing that's just who they are. But it's not who you are. It's just who you've been practicing to be. When you start observing yourself, you rise above your old patterns. That's when real transformation begins. A new thought leads to a new choice. A new choice creates a new action. A new action brings a new experience. And that experience gives birth to a new emotion. Now, your body begins to feel what your mind has learned. And that's how change becomes real. That's how you evolve. If you're from the U.S. or any Western country, comment your country below and write E-book. And I'll send you my Meditation Guide E-book for free. It's time to quiet the mind and begin your transformation.
